title: Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra ve Nvidia RTX Spark işlemciler duyuruldu
summary: Microsoft ve Nvidia, yeni RTX Spark işlemcilerden güç alan amiral gemisi Surface Laptop Ultra dizüstü bilgisayarı tanıttı.
body:
Microsoft, üst düzey profesyonelleri ve içerik üreticilerini hedefleyen yeni amiral gemisi taşınabilir bilgisayarı Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra modelini resmi olarak duyurdu. San Francisco'daki etkinlikte tanıtılan cihaz, Nvidia'nın yeni nesil RTX Spark işlemci platformundan güç alıyor. ShiftDelete.Net'in aktardığına göre, ön siparişe açılan modelin başlangıç fiyatı 2.599 dolar olarak belirlendi.

## Nvidia RTX Spark ve donanım özellikleri

Cihazın kalbinde yer alan Nvidia RTX Spark N1X platformu, geleneksel işlemci ve harici grafik kartı ayrımını ortadan kaldırıyor. Tepe modelde 20 çekirdekli Nvidia Grace CPU ve 6.144 çekirdekli Blackwell mimarili RTX GPU bir arada çalışıyor. Sistem, Apple Silicon tarafında olduğu gibi 128 GB’a kadar LPDDR5X birleşik belleği destekliyor. Digital Trends'in aktardığına göre, bilgisayar pil üzerindeyken tepe performansının yüzde 99'unu koruyabiliyor ve bir petaflop yapay zeka işlem gücü sunuyor.

## Ekran, tasarım ve çıkış tarihi

Surface Laptop Ultra, 18 mm’den ince kasası ve yaklaşık 2 kg ağırlığıyla taşınabilirliğini korurken, 15 inç boyutundaki PixelSense Ultra mini-LED ekranında 2.000 nit tepe HDR parlaklık sunuyor. Tom's Hardware'in haberine göre, cihazlar 16 Ekim'de kargoya verilecek. Ayrıca Asus, Dell, Lenovo, HP ve MSI gibi üreticilerin bu işlemciye sahip bilgisayarları da yıl içinde raflarda yerini alacak.

**Neden önemli?** Yeni nesil Nvidia işlemciler ve Windows 11 güncellemeleri, kişisel bilgisayarlarda yapay zeka ajanları ve yerel model entegrasyonu için köklü bir dönüm noktası oluşturuyor.

source_texts.text:
Nvidia RTX Spark İşlemcili Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra Tanıtıldı
Microsoft, üst düzey profesyonelleri ve içerik üreticilerini hedefleyen yeni amiral gemisi taşınabilir bilgisayarı Surface Laptop Ultra’yı resmi olarak duyurdu.
Nvidia’nın Arm tabanlı yeni nesil RTX Spark N1X işlemci platformundan güç alan 15 inçlik bilgisayar; 128 GB’a kadar birleşik bellek desteği, mini-LED ekranı ve yenilikçi manyetik şarj mekanizmasıyla doğrudan Apple MacBook Pro modellerini hedef alıyor. Ön siparişe açılan modelin başlangıç fiyatı 2.599 dolar olarak belirlendi.
Nvidia RTX Spark Mimarisi: 128 GB Birleşik Bellek ve Grace CPU
Surface Laptop Ultra’nın kalbinde yer alan Nvidia RTX Spark N1X platformu, geleneksel x86 işlemci ve harici grafik kartı ayrımını ortadan kaldırıyor. Tepe modelde 20 çekirdekli Nvidia Grace CPU ve 6.144 çekirdekli Blackwell mimarili RTX GPU bir arada çalışıyor.
Sistem, Apple Silicon tarafında olduğu gibi hem işlemcinin hem de grafik biriminin aynı bellek havuzuna doğrudan erişebildiği 128 GB’a kadar LPDDR5X birleşik bellek (unified memory) mimarisini kullanıyor.
Windows Görev Yöneticisi üzerinde 128 GB’lık modelin yaklaşık 110 GB’ı grafik birimine atanabilir bellek olarak görüntülenebiliyor.
Serinin giriş seviyesinde ise 18 çekirdekli işlemci, 5.120 GPU çekirdeği ve 64 GB’a kadar destekleyen konfigürasyon yer alıyor.
Cihazın güç tüketimi (TDP) 45W ile 80W arasında yapılandırılabiliyor. Microsoft, yenilenen soğutma sisteminin Surface Laptop 7’ye kıyasla 2,5 kat daha yüksek termal kapasite sunduğunu ve cihazın prizden çıkarıldığında da performansının yüzde 99’unu koruduğunu belirtiyor.
2.000 Nit Mini-LED Ekran ve Manyetik USB-C Çözümü
Surface Laptop Ultra, 18 mm’den daha ince kasası ve yaklaşık 2 kg (4,5 lb) ağırlığıyla taşınabilirliğini koruyor. 15 inç boyutundaki PixelSense Ultra mini-LED dokunmatik ekran, 3:2 en-boy oranı, 262 PPI piksel yoğunluğu ve 2.000 nit tepe HDR parlaklık değerine ulaşıyor.
Cihazın dokunsal geri bildirim destekli hassas dokunmatik yüzeyi (trackpad) ise önceki Surface modellerine göre yüzde 30 daha geniş tasarlanıyor.
Bağlantı noktaları konusunda da zengin bir altyapı sunan modelde USB-C, USB-A, tam boyutlu HDMI, 3,5 mm kulaklık jakı ve tam boyutlu SD kart okuyucu bulunuyor. Şarj tarafında ise tescilli özel şarj soketleri yerine, standart kabloların çekilme anında güvenle ayrılmasını sağlayan entegre manyetik mekanizmalı USB-C şarj mimarisi tercih ediliyor.
Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra Fiyatı ve Konfigürasyonları
Platinum ve Nightfall renk seçenekleriyle satışa çıkan Surface Laptop Ultra’nın başlangıç modeli 18 çekirdekli RTX Spark işlemci, 24 GB RAM ve 512 GB SSD depolama ile 2.599 dolardan ön siparişe açıldı. 20 çekirdekli işlemci, 128 GB RAM ve 1 TB SSD barındıran en üst seviye konfigürasyon ise 5.899,99 dolarlık etiketle listeleniyor.

source_texts.title: Microsoft introduces Surface Laptop Ultra powerhouse with Nvidia Spark inside
source_texts.summary: Armed with a mini-LED screen, plenty of ports, and advanced thermals, Surface Laptop Ultra starts at $2599 and it's now up for pre-orders, pitting it against Apple's MacBook Pro.
source_texts.text:
Microsoft has just introduced its flagship laptop, the Surface Laptop Ultra, with Nvidia’s RTX Spark silicon inside. The sleek laptop, which arrives as a spiritual successor to the Surface Laptop, is the company’s most powerful laptop and is directly targeted at users who require extreme workloads.
The laptop comes equipped with a 15-inch miniLED touch-sensitive display and a metallic chassis that is just 18 millimeters thick and tips the scales at under two 4.5 pounds. Notably, it also supports magnetic charging via the USB-C port, which is a neat addition. The star of the show, of course, is the Nvidia silicon at its heart.
It lands Nvidia’s RTX Spark processor that comes with an RTX graphics engine ticking alongside it, married to the biggest thermal architecture (2.5x bigger) Microsoft has ever shipped within a laptop. The company notes that the Surface Laptop Ultra maintains nearly 99% of its peak power while on battery, which is a huge lift.
Since this is a machine targeted at AI professionals, the company is touting the one petaflop of AI compute on the machine. The device also gets a replaceable and user-serviceable SSD drive, while the memory options go all the way up to 128GB. Compared to a MacBook Pro with an M5 Pro chip, Microsoft says the Surface Laptop Ultra is 2.1x faster at first token generation, 4.3x faster at image generation, and 6.2x snappier at image generation.
“Designed around NVIDIA RTX Spark, Surface Laptop Ultra unites an NVIDIA Blackwell RTX GPU with up to 6,144 cores, an NVIDIA Grace CPU with up to 20 cores, and up to 128 GB of unified memory,” says the company in a blog post.
It comes in two color options — silver and dark grey — and is now up for pre-orders. The Surface Laptop Ultra starts at $2599 and it goes straight against Apple’s MacBook Pro. To go with it, the company has also announced that the Surface RTX Spark Dev Box will be shipping with a sticker price of $5,999 attached to it.

source_texts.title: Microsoft and Nvidia launch Surface Laptop Ultra with RTX Spark
source_texts.summary: Microsoft's Surface Laptop Ultra is now available for pre-order. The company revealed some new Windows 11 features, a new magnetic USB Type-C port, and that the system will work with "hundreds" of video games.
source_texts.text:
At an event in San Francisco, Microsoft and Nvidia teamed up to show off the RTX Spark chip, along with the Surface Laptop Ultra and new features in Windows 11 that use the new system-on-a-chip's capabilities. The device, along with the Surface RTX Spark Dev Box and the broader Spark ecosystem is available for pre-order today, with devices shipping on October 16. 
Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, and Windows and Devices head Pavan Davuluri took turns on stage.
"We've reinvented the personal computer completely," Huang said.
Nadella described the event as one that would be building the "frontier ecosystem," anchoring it in Agent 365, Microsoft IQ, and Copilot. Davuluri describes Windows 11 as being the most secure platform for AI agents, highlighting containment for agents.
Windows 11 and Surface Laptop Ultra
The Surface Laptop Ultra will start at $2,599, while the Surface RTX Spark Dev Box will begin at $5,999. Both are available for pre-order. They, along with PCs from Asus, Dell, Lenovo, HP, and MSI will ship next Friday, Oct. 16.
Davuluri showed the Surface Laptop Ultra running Github Copilot and playing Gears of War: E-Day at 60 frames per second. He said that "hundreds" of AAA titles and indies will be available day one, and that Call of Duty will come to RTX Spark in 2027.
The 4.5-pound system has the brightest peak HDR on a laptop, he said. The system also features a magnetic USB-C charger it calls "magnetic connect." The connector plugs in, similar to Apple's MagSafe or the old Surface Connect ports, except using a standardized port.
An impressive video demo using multiple local and cloud models across Blender, Photoshop, ComfyUI, and Unreal Engine to make a workload that took hours instead of days was impressive, but also highly produced.
Microsoft compared the Spark to the M5 Pro in a MacBook Pro, promising performance up to 2.1 times faster to first token, 4.3 times faster image generation, and 6.2 times faster video generation.
Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.
On Windows 11, there will be new quick actions in the Search menu in the Task Bar, making quick changes to settings, taking screenshots, or arranging windows using natural language. The Taskbar will also launch Copilot if the request calls for it, and you can jump from Search to Copilot.
Davuluri also described local models running from other vendors, including Hermes, OpenClaw, and Perplexity, performing a demo with Perplexity Computer. He also stated that Meta's Muse will come to Windows. There will be a new setup for Windows AI agents to make them easier to configure.
Davaluri also announced DGX Spark and Station for Windows, a "supercomputer" to bring "last quarter's frontier to your desktop." He showed off desktops from HP and Dell that will come "later this year." Up to this point, both have been exclusive for Linux.
Copilot and Local Agents
Microsoft's Jacob Andreou detailed the recent launch of the new Copilot, which is now getting access to local files, local models, and the ability to take actions on account of the user. It will still use cloud models, but will switch to local models when privacy is called for.
In one example, Andreou was grabbing tax data for his accountant. The system used a mix of local and cloud models to search for documents, rename them, and zip them into a folder. Copilot also wrote an email to the accountant to send on his behalf, which he approved. These features, he said, are coming over the next few months.
Containers, Trust, and Hybrid Ingelligence
Daviluri focused on the technical details of agents, including Microsoft Execution Containers, which is moving to general availability. These are sandboxes that are integrated with the OS to decide what data is shared with agents.
Windows will also require agents to attribute their actions to themselves. There will be IT actions for enterprises that want to set agentic rules once and use them across their fleet of devices.
Microsoft's Divya Venkataramu demonstrated this system, showing how she had access to documents even when agents didn't.
Davuluri also described hybrid intelligence, a mix of agents running locally and in the cloud to reduce token budgets. Microsoft's HydraFusion, which balances local and cloud agents, is coming from GitHub to Windows on October 15 for GitHub Copilot, the CLI, and VS Code, and will use new models like MAI Code 1.1 Flash and Nvidia's Nemotron. Using advanced quantization, DeepSeek V4 Flash can be used at 1.6 bits to run locally at 60GB of memory, he said.
Windows ML will serve as the runtime to deploy models across GPU, NPU, and CPU. Llama.cpp will come to Windows ML to give developers chances to experiment with new models at launch.
Microsoft's Kayla Cinnamon demonstrated Hybrid intelligence on a Surface RTX Dev Box by prompting GitHub Copilot to detect unused codes, packages, and feature flags to clean up code. With an Efficiency mode, Copilot selects a model automatically based on how complex a task is. A more complex prompt used GPT-6 Luna, while separate sub-agents ran locally.
